tasks.label: Analyze and Preprocess Benchmarks
tasks.command: bash experiments/bench_preprocess.sh --input-dir Norn --process-script scripts/preprocess.py --output-dir Norn-preprocessed --log-dir results/preprocess --log-file Norn-preprocess.log --excel-dir charts --excel-file Norn.xlsx

tasks.label: Run CVC5 Tests
tasks.command: bash experiments/bench_solve.sh --input-dir Norn --output-dir results --task cvc5 --solver cvc5 --timeout 10 --parallel 20 --excel-dir charts --excel-file Norn.xlsx

tasks.label: Run CVC5-Preprocess Tests
tasks.command: bash experiments/bench_solve.sh --input-dir Norn-preprocessed --output-dir results --task cvc5-preprocess --solver cvc5 --timeout 10 --parallel 20 --excel-dir charts --excel-file Norn.xlsx

tasks.label: Process All Results
tasks.command: python experiments/analysis_solve.py --input-excel charts/Norn.xlsx --log-dir results/cvc5 results/cvc5-preprocess --output-file charts/Norn_updated.xlsx

tasks.label: Git Commit and Push force
tasks.command: git add . && git commit --no-edit --amend && git push origin main --force
